data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 60–61):** **`مِنْ`** ka matlab **'se / mein se'** hai. Iske baad aane wale ism ke neeche **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aati hai: `مِنَ الْكِتَابِ` (Kitaab se), `مِنْ طِينٍ` (mitti se).
